text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
AUSTRALIA, Jan 13 - COAL - QUEENSLAND - Abbot Point - Berth vacant, 5 vessels due by 27/1, no delays.
Dalrymple Bay - One vessel loading, 2 waiting, 13 due by 25/1, approx. 1-2 days delay expected.
Hay Point - Two vessels loading, 10 due by 27/1, no delays.
Gladstone - R.G. Tanna - 1 Vessel loading, 3 waiting, 10 due by 1/2/,approx. 1-2 days delay expected.
Barney Point - 1 Vessel loading, 1 waiting, 1 due 17/1, approx. 1 days delay expected.
Brisbane - Berth vacant, 2 vessels due by 26/1, no delays.
NEW SOUTH WALES - Newcastle - Kooragang - 2 Vessels loading, 2 waiting, 9 due by 24/1, approx. 4-5 days delay expected.
Channel (Dyke) - 2 Vessels loading, 7 waiting, 8 due by 25/1, approx. 4-5 days delay expected.
Port Kembla - One vessel loading, 4 waiting, 11 due by 20/2, approx. 3-4 days delay expected.
IRON ORE - WESTERN AUSTRALIA - Port Hedland - Mt. Newman (Nelson Point) A berth - 9 Vessels due by 23/1. B berth - 1 vessel loading, 7 due by 19/1, 5 others due by 29/1, no eta receive.
Goldsworthy (Finucane Island) - 1 Vessel loading, 3 due by 24/1.
Dampier - Parker Point - 1 Vessel loading, 4 anchored.
East Intercourse Island - 1 Vessel loading, 1 anchored, 3 due by 15/1.
Dampier line up - 10 Vessels due by 29/1 of which 6 for Parker Point, 4 for East Intercourse Island.
Port Walcott - One vessel loading, 1 berthed, 9 due by 29/1.
GRAIN, Jan 15 - QUEENSLAND - Mackay, Gladstone - No vessels due.
Brisbane - Two vessels waiting to load wheat, 4 due by 25/1, all to load wheat.
NEW SOUTH WALES - Newcastle - One vessel loading wheat, 6 due by 31/1 of which 4 to load wheat, 2 barley.
Port Kembla - One vessel loading wheat, 2 waiting to load of which 1 wheat, 1 barley. 2 Vessels due by 23/1, both to load barley.
VICTORIA - Geelong - One vessel loading canola, 1 waiting to load wheat. 10 Vessels due by 15/2 of which 5 to load wheat, 5 barley.
Portland - Six vessels due by 1/2 of which 1 to load canola, 1 barley, 4 wheat.
SOUTH AUSTRALIA - Port Pirie - Three vessels due by 28/1, all to load wheat.
Port Adelaide - One vessel loading malt, 5 due by 24/1 of which 2 to load barley, 1 beans, 2 wheat.
Thevenard - One vessel due 25/1 to load wheat.
Port Lincoln - One vessel loading wheat/barley/peas, 7 due by 31/1 of which 6 to load wheat, 1 wheat/barley/oats.
Wallaroo - One vessel waiting to load wheat, 4 due by 3/2 of which 1 to load beans, 3 wheat.
Ardrossan - One vessel waiting to load barley, 1 due 16/1 to load barley.
Port Giles - Six vessels due by 6/2 of which 2 to load barley, 4 wheat.
WESTERN AUSTRALIA - Geraldton - Grain berth to close from 15/1 for a period of 5-6 weeks for major reconstruction.
Kwinana - Four vessels waiting of which 3 to load wheat, 1 lupins. 5 Vessels due by 31/1, all to load wheat.
Albany - One vessel loading wheat, 1 waiting to load wheat. 3 Vessels due by 25/1 of which 2 to load wheat, 1 barley.
Esperance - One vessel loading barley, 4 due by 20/1 of which 2 to load barley, 2 wheat.
